resources.string: Installed: Minecraft Bedrock %1$s. See Dashboard → Modules for mod availability.
Minecraft Bedrock is not installed. Install or update it through your store.
Android could not open Minecraft. Check that the official Bedrock app is installed and enabled.
Import visual modules as resource packs. Legacy modules are listed but not active in this build.
Legacy module · Not available in game
After Minecraft confirms import, go to Settings → Global Resources → My Packs and activate the Xelo pack. Disable it there to undo the change. Xelo cannot verify activation.
Sent to Minecraft. Check its import confirmation, then activate the pack in Global Resources.
Sent to Minecraft. The game will report whether it imported the file.
This file is too large for the 512 MB import cache, or the cache is full. Try opening it from Files in Minecraft.
Xelo could not read or prepare the file. Select it again to retry.
Minecraft did not accept the file from Xelo. Try opening it directly from Files.
Import stopped because Xelo was no longer in front. Try again.
Try Hotbar 1–9 as an experimental touch pack. Select slots here, then import and activate the pack in Minecraft. Other touch modules are preview only.
Preview only · Not available in Minecraft
This is the old Xelo layout editor. Its size, position and opacity settings do not change the Hotbar pack or the installed game.
Select at least one Hotbar slot below.

After import, open Minecraft: Settings → Global Resources → My Packs. Activate Xelo - Hotbar (%1$s), and disable any earlier Xelo Hotbar pack. If the same pack is already imported, just activate it.\n\nIn a local world, use touch controls and test the numbered buttons above the normal hotbar. To remove them, disable the pack in Minecraft. Xelo cannot verify import or activation.
Pack saved. Open the .mcpack in Minecraft from the Files app, then activate it in Global Resources.
Could not save the Hotbar pack. Try another folder or use Import.
Minecraft could not open the pack from Xelo. Choose Save .mcpack and open it in Minecraft from the Files app.
Launch only opens Minecraft. To try Hotbar shortcuts, import a pack from Touch Modules and activate it in Minecraft.
Open your installed Minecraft Bedrock game, or go to Dashboard → Modules to try the visual resource packs.
